Shaggy, messy ash-blonde hair with long bangs covering the forehead. Sharp, wide-set amber eyes with a mischievous expression. Apparent age is a late adolescent with a lean, youthful maturity. Slender, lithe build. Wears a white and gold high-collared tunic with a navy blue capelet and brown leather boots. Signature details include a small gold earring in one ear and a focused, cunning gaze.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
